value.name: Devin signs the filing
value.description: Devin finally takes the pen, signs the document without looking at Asha, and returns the filing to her side.
evidence: Devin's hand finally moved. He drew the pen toward him across the page, uncapped it with his thumb, and signed the line without looking up at her, and then he slid the filing back into her side of the lamp's circle

value.name: Devin promises to deliver filing Monday
value.description: Devin says he will personally walk the filing into Whitfield's office on Monday.
evidence: said he would walk it into Whitfield's office himself on Monday

value.name: Asha leaves with the signed page
value.description: Asha gathers the signed page into her briefcase and leaves into the cold night.
evidence: Asha gathered the page into the briefcase and let herself out into the November cold

value.name: Asha discovers missed calls and Claire's email
value.description: Back in her apartment, Asha finds three ignored voicemails from a 609 number and an email from Claire Donato revealing Marcus's hospitalization and the failed wire transfer.
evidence: it was not until she was inside her own apartment, coat still on, that she saw the three voicemails from a 609 number she had been ignoring since Wednesday and the email beneath them from a woman named Claire Donato, who had written that she was Marcus's wife, that Marcus had been in the hospital since Friday morning, and that the wire transfer Asha had been waiting on had not gone through because Marcus did not have the money he had told her on Tuesday that he had.
value.time_hint: since Wednesday; since Friday morning; Tuesday

value.name: Asha rereads Claire's email
value.description: Asha reads Claire's message multiple times, absorbing the bad news without even removing her coat.
evidence: Asha read Claire's email twice through without taking off her coat, then a third time standing at the kitchen counter with one hand braced against the laminate.

value.name: Asha avoids delaying tasks
value.description: Asha sets the phone down and tosses her coat over a chair instead of hanging it up, acting with urgency and impatience.
evidence: She set the phone face-down, finally shrugged the coat from her shoulders and laid it over the back of the chair instead of hanging it, because hanging it would have taken another minute she did not have.

value.name: Asha calls the 609 number
value.description: Seeing the repeated missed calls, Asha dials the 609 number before deciding how to speak to whoever answers.
evidence: The 609 number was still at the top of her recent calls, three unanswered marks beside it from Wednesday and Thursday and Friday, and she pressed it before she had decided what voice she was going to use when a stranger picked up.

value.name: Call begins to connect
value.description: The phone rings once as Asha's call starts to go through, ending the scene on the moment before someone answers.
